subject: [PATCH v2 11/12] mm/collapse: declare the collapse interface in collapse.h

reviews.author: Kiryl Shutsemau (author)
reviews.summary: Author is addressing Zi Yan's feedback about adding more comments to explain the collapse interface, specifically per-function comments in addition to an overview comment. The author agrees to add these comments and will do so by adding a comment to each function at its definition.
reviews.raw_body:
I will add a comment to each function at its definition: what it needs,
what it does, and what state the lock is in on entry and exit.

The overview stays. Per-function comments tell you about one call at a
time; the overview is what ties the four together and says in which
order they are made and who holds the lock in between.

-- 
  Kiryl Shutsemau / Kirill A. Shutemov

2026-09-14.patch_summary: This patch declares the collapse interface in collapse.h, making it possible to use the collapse functionality from other kernel files. The interface includes four functions: collapse_control_init, collapse_scan_pmd, collapse_run_pmd, and collapse_control_release, which are called in a specific order with the mmap_lock held at different times. Additionally, two new functions are added: collapse_possible_orders and collapse_vma_revalidate. This patch is part of a larger effort to implement MADV_COLLAPSE in madvise.c and does not introduce any functional changes.
